item.title: Astlibra
item.description:
I just finished this game after grabbing it during the sale because I heard a lot of good things about it from /v/irgins, can we have a thread?

I didn't enjoy the game very much, lots of backtracking and grinding, and combat in the late game got way too projectile spammy and hard to keep track of. I couldn't actually determine the cause of most of my deaths past Chapter 5 or so, might have been because I was playing on Hell.
